title: Residency Proofstream and Tenant Crypto Anchors
creator: Sofia Chen
description: Build a production-ready 'Proofstream' backend that continuously assembles cryptographically verifiable residency records for Dedicated capacity tenants. The service will create compact evidence bundles (location assertions, node manifests, retention policy stamps) signed with a hardware-backed key (tenant crypto anchor) and expose an API and export pipeline for auditors and customer security teams. This ticket covers the core proof assembly, signing flow, and export orchestration; separate follow-ups will handle UI and long-term storage optimization.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Proofstream can ingest node metadata, placement topology, and retention configuration on a 5-minute cadence and produce a signed bundle for a given tenant.
2) Bundles include a manifest, timebound retention stamps, and hashes of the VM/GPU images used to host the tenant workload.
3) Signing is done with a KMS-backed key that supports key rotation; verify verification endpoint can validate bundle signatures.
4) API endpoints: POST /proofs/trigger, GET /proofs/{tenant}/{timestamp}, and a gzipped export endpoint for auditors.
5) End-to-end tests and CI gate that validates signature verification against test vectors.
6) Performance: proof generation latency < 30s for 1000-tenant batch runs; export throughput >= 50 bundles/min.
7) Documented runbook for operators and an initial compliance artifact mapped to SOC2 control template.
non_functional_requirements:
- Proof bundles must be tamper-evident and verifiable offline.
- Minimal PII in bundles; any customer data must be hashed with salt and referenced only by tenant ID.
- Service should be horizontally scalable and able to backfill 90 days of bundle history.
- Audit export must support incremental delta exports and full snapshots.
- Observe 99.9% availability within Dedicated control plane SLA.
implementation_plan:
Phase 1: Schema & ingestion (week 1) - define bundle schema, build connectors to placement service and retention config.
Phase 2: Signing abstraction (week 2) - integrate with KMS/HSM, implement tenant crypto anchor support and key rotation workflows.
Phase 3: Proof assembler & export (week 3) - assemble bundles, attach VP- style claims, implement gzipped export and S3 sink with ACLs.
Phase 4: Verification API & CI (week 4) - implement signature verification, test vectors, and CI checks.
Phase 5: Hardening & runbook (week 5) - monitoring, alerts, and operator runbook.
Implementation notes: start with dev KMS emulator, then switch to AWS KMS/CloudHSM in staging. Use protobuf for bundle format for compactness and forward compatibility.
rollout_plan:
- Canary: enable for 3 pilot tenants in staging dedicated cluster; validate exports with security team.
- Beta: enable for 10 customers, generate daily bundles and manual audit review.
- GA: enable org-wide with automated weekly exports and a dashboard link for compliance teams.
- Fallback: on signer failures, switch to asynchronous signing queue and emit 'unsigned' bundles with error code for operator attention.
testing_plan:
- Unit tests for schema encoder/decoder and signature flows.
- Integration tests using KMS emulator and synthetic placement data.
- Load test simulating 5k tenants producing bundles every 5 minutes; verify latency and throughput.
- Security fuzzing on bundle parsing and verification endpoints.
- Compliance smoke test that maps generated artifacts to SOC2 control IDs.
